text_description: Full-length runway look in a dark, nearly black palette, built around a long high-neck knit dress or tunic with a close turtleneck collar rising to the jaw, long straight sleeves, softly extended shoulders, and a loose column-to-cocoon silhouette that narrows slightly toward the lower leg. The main black garment reads matte and dense, falling below the knee with clean minimal surfaces and a subtle rounded volume through the body; at the lower hem, a camel-brown underlayer or skirt panel is visible, edged with irregular angular points and decorated with white dashed stitch-like markings running horizontally and diagonally. The model wears a tall black bucket/cloche-style hat with a high crown and downward brim that partly shades the face, with small delicate eyewear or face jewelry visible beneath. Styling is completed with glossy black knee-high boots with a wrinkled shaft, pointed toe, and slim heel, plus a small structured black handbag carried at one side by a short handle, adding a polished leather contrast to the otherwise soft, covered silhouette. The overall mood is austere, elongated, and protective, with monochrome black layering broken only by the brown-and-white graphic hem detail.
key_elements: black high turtleneck long-sleeve knit dress or tunic
loose column/cocoon silhouette below the knee
camel-brown visible underlayer with white dashed stitch-like markings
uncertainty_notes: The exact closure and material composition are not visible.
The face detail appears to be small eyewear or delicate face jewelry but is partly obscured by the hat brim.
